July 5, 41.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
S H A N G H A I.

Sir,
I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. 2908-496, dated June 15, 1941, and to inform
you the number of Russians residing in Shanghai
totals about 25,000, which figure includes about
1,200 Soviet citizens.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（批：7 7 #）
K.M. BOURNE
Commissioner of Police.

CSC.

REPORT

Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date July 4, 1941.

SUBJECT: Communication dated 25-6-41 from the Netherlands Consulate-General requesting information regarding numerical strength of local Russian community.

No accurate statistical data are available regarding the numerical strength of the local Russian community. In some of the recent articles in the local press dealing with the affairs of that community the number of Russian residents in Shanghai was variously estimated at 30,000, 35,000 and in one instance even at 40,000. However, information obtained from more or less authoritative sources indicates that the above figures are incorrect.

In April, 1938 the reorganized Russian Emigrants Committee in Shanghai commenced a re-registration of local Russian emigrants. Up to December, 1940 a total of 17,881 persons were registered comprised as follows:-

Men 6,912
Women 8,366
Boys } under 18 years of age 1,343
Girls } 1,260
Total 17,881

During the first six months of the current year additional 1,566 persons were registered ( 618 men, 779 women, 92 boys and 77 girls ) bringing the total number of Russian emigrants registered to-date to, roughly, 20,000.

To this must be added a small number of emigrants of Ukrainian origin who are registered with the Ukrainian Emigrants Committee, a certain number of naturalized Chinese citizens of Russian origin who are under

（左侧方框内文字）
Commr. of Police.
Sir:
Information
（签名）
A. C. (Sp. Br.)

报告

特务科分局。档案号.................... 日期 1941年7月4日。

主题：荷兰总领事馆1941年6月25日来函，询及本地俄国侨民人数。

关于本地俄国侨民的人数，并无准确的统计数据。在本地报刊近期一些涉及该侨民事务的文章中，对上海俄国居民人数的估计各不相同，分别为30,000、35,000，甚至有一例高达40,000。然而，从较为权威的来源获得的信息表明，上述数字并不正确。

1938年4月，改组后的上海俄国侨民委员会开始对本地俄国侨民进行重新登记。截至1940年12月，登记总人数为17,881人，构成如下：-

男子 6,912
女子 8,366
男孩 } 18岁以下 1,343
女孩 } 1,260
总计 17,881

在今年上半年，又有1,566人进行了登记（男子618人，女子779人，男孩92人，女孩77人），使迄今登记的俄国侨民总数大致达到20,000人。

此外，还需加上在乌克兰侨民委员会登记的一小部分乌克兰籍侨民，一定数量的已入中国籍的俄裔人士（他们无义务向该委员会登记），以及

（左侧方框内文字）
警务处处长。
先生：
情报
（签名）
A. C. (特务科)

SUBJECT:
no obligation to register with the Committee and a num-
ber of Russian emigrants who for various reasons have so
far failed to apply for registration at the Committee.
It is believed that the last named group is still fairly
large.

In view of the fact that, according to passport
regulations enforced by the Japanese authorities, all Rus-
sian emigrants arriving in Shanghai from the North for
a short sojourn must also register with the Russian Emi-
grants Committee, a certain deduction should be made from
the total figure furnished by the Russian Emigrants
Committee in order to determine the number of Russian
nationals actually residing in Shanghai.

Unlike the emigrant section of the Russian com-
munity, no official data are available regarding the nu-
merical strength of the Soviet section. Recently a lo-
cal Soviet newspaper published an interview with Mr. Ze-
phiroff, Chairman of the Soviet Citizens' Club in Shanghai,
in which he stated that there are over 600 Soviet citi-
zens in this city and in addition about 1,500 of emi-
grants who have applied for Soviet citizenship and hold
certificates to that effect. Communicated with in con-
nection with this matter Mr. Zephiroff confirmed this in-
formation. It would appear therefore that the number of
actual Soviet citizens in Shanghai, families included,
cannot be more than 1,200 .

All things considered, it would appear that the
total number of Russian residents in Shanghai does not
exceed 25,000.

A.C. ( Special Branch ).

A. Prokofieff
D.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告
- 2 -

分局。档案号.................... 日期....................................

主题：
无义务向该委员会登记，以及一部分因各种原因至今未向该委员会申请登记的俄国侨民。据信，最后这一群体的人数仍然相当庞大。

鉴于根据日本当局执行的护照规定，所有从北方抵达上海短期停留的俄国侨民也必须向俄国侨民委员会登记，因此，为了确定实际居住在上海的俄国国民人数，应从俄国侨民委员会提供的总数中扣除相应部分。

与俄国侨民中的流亡者部分不同，关于苏联部分的人数，没有官方数据。最近，本地一家苏联报纸刊登了对上海苏联公民俱乐部主席泽菲罗夫（Zephireff）先生的采访，他在采访中表示，本市有600多名苏联公民，此外还有约1,500名已申请苏联国籍并持有相关证明的侨民。就此事项与泽菲罗夫先生联系后，他证实了这一信息。因此，上海的实际苏联公民人数（包括家属）似乎不超过1,200人。

综上所述，上海俄国居民的总数似乎不超过25,000人。

A.C. (特务科)。

A. Prokofieff
副督察。

authoritative sources indicates that the above figures
are incorrect.

In April, 1938 the reorganized Russian Emigrants
Committee in Shanghai commenced a re-registration of lo-
cal Russian emigrants. Up to December, 1940 a total of

During the first six months of the current year
additional 1,866 persons were registered ( 618 men,
779 women, 92 boys and 77 girls ) bringing the total num-
ber of Russian emigrants registered to-date to, roughly,
20,000.

To this must be added a small number of emi-
grants of Ukrainian origin who are registered with the

ralised Chinese citizens of Russian origin who are under

关于本地俄国侨民的人数，并无准确的统计数据。在本地报刊近期一些涉及该侨民事务的文章中，对上海俄国居民人数的估计各不相同，分别为30,000、35,000，甚至有一例高达40,000。然而，从较为权威的来源获得的信息表明，上述数字并不正确。

1938年4月，改组后的上海俄国侨民委员会开始对本地俄国侨民进行重新登记。截至1940年12月，登记总人数为17,881人，构成如下：-

男子 6,912
女子 8,366
男孩 } 18岁以下 1,343
女孩 } 1,260
总计 17,881

在今年上半年，又有1,866人进行了登记（男子618人，女子779人，男孩92人，女孩77人），使迄今登记的俄国侨民总数大致达到20,000人。

此外，还需加上在乌克兰侨民委员会登记的一小部分乌克兰籍侨民，一定数量的已入中国籍的俄裔人士（他们无义务

no obligation to register with the Committee and a number of Russian emigrants who for various reasons have so far failed to apply for registration at the Committee.
It is believed that the last named group is still fairly large.

In view of the fact that, according to passport regulations enforced by the Japanese authorities, all Russian emigrants arriving in Shanghai from the North for a short sojourn must also register with the Russian Emigrants Committee, a certain deduction should be made from the total figure furnished by the Russian Emigrants Committee in order to determine the number of Russian nationals actually residing in Shanghai.

Unlike the emigrant section of the Russian community, no official data are available regarding the numerical strength of the Soviet section. Recently a local Soviet newspaper published an interview with Mr. Zephireff, Chairman of the Soviet Citizens' Club in Shanghai in which he stated that there are over 600 Soviet citizens in this city and in addition about 1,800 of emigrants who have applied for Soviet citizenship and hold certificates to that effect. Communicated with in connection with this matter Mr. Zephireff confirmed this information. It would appear therefore that the number of actual Soviet citizens in Shanghai, families included, cannot be more than 1,200 .

All things considered, it would appear that the total number of Russian residents in Shanghai does not exceed 25,000.

据信，最后这一群体的人数仍然相当庞大。

鉴于根据日本当局执行的护照规定，所有从北方抵达上海短期停留的俄国侨民也必须向俄国侨民委员会登记，因此，为了确定实际居住在上海的俄国国民人数，应从俄国侨民委员会提供的总数中扣除相应部分。

与俄国侨民中的流亡者部分不同，关于苏联部分的人数，没有官方数据。最近，本地一家苏联报纸刊登了对上海苏联公民俱乐部主席泽菲罗夫（Zephireff）先生的采访，他在采访中表示，本市有600多名苏联公民，此外还有约1,800名已申请苏联国籍并持有相关证明的侨民。就此事项与泽菲罗夫先生联系后，他证实了这一信息。因此，上海的实际苏联公民人数（包括家属）似乎不超过1,200人。

综上所述，上海俄国居民的总数似乎不超过25,000人。
